races.name: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Lisnamurrican
runners_data.note: Front runner with highest class but 91 days off and needs to prove fitness despite Henderson's skill with returning horses

runners_data.name: That Is Blue
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner but moderate ability, will need career best to compete with class horses here
runners_data.comment: Third in a bumper and maiden hurdle but more will be needed here
runners_data.spotlight: Third in a Wincanton bumper (1m7f, heavy) and Plumpton maiden hurdle (2m4f, good) just under ten weeks apart; has ability but will need to raise her game to seriously trouble Lisnamurrican and Strong Run.

runners_data.name: Strong Run
runners_data.note: In-form prominent runner with recent hurdles wins, carries 7lbs extra but best current form in field
runners_data.comment: Unable to make an impact in EBF final latest but should have a big say back in a novice
runners_data.spotlight: Did well in bumpers and came good at the second attempt over hurdles at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) in December; bettered that form when second at Wincanton (2m5f, heavy) in January; unable to make an impact in the EBF mares' final (handicap) at Newbury last month but bold show looks assured back in a novice.

runners_data.name: Grey Gamble
runners_data.note: Natural leader but 155 days absence and moderate bumper form suggests unlikely to handle this class rise
runners_data.comment: Only minor promise in bumpers ahead of hurdle debut after five months off
runners_data.spotlight: Showed a bit when midfield in a couple of bumpers but not enough to suggest she's likely to make a winning start over hurdles after five months off.

runners_data.name: Madmoiselle Moss
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but tailed off in both bumpers and switching to hurdles unlikely to spark improvement
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in two bumpers ahead of switch to hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in two bumpers ahead of this switch to hurdles.

runners_data.name: Pink Perjury
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but completely outclassed based on poor bumper efforts, lacks any form of recommendation
runners_data.comment: Always behind in two bumpers ahead of switch to hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Always behind in two bumpers and likely booked for another struggle now hurdling.

runners_data.name: Precious Jean
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with wind operation and tongue-tie first time but has shown nothing over hurdles previously
runners_data.comment: No form over hurdles; wind op (also tongue-tied) needs to spark huge improvement
runners_data.spotlight: No sign of ability over hurdles, including a low-grade handicap; a wind operation since last seen (also tongue-tied first time) needs to spark huge improvement.

races.paceDynamic: Lisnamurrican and Grey Gamble are confirmed early leaders who will contest the pace from the start, creating an honest gallop over this extended trip. Strong Run and That Is Blue will track the leaders in prominent positions, while the hold-up horses Pink Perjury and Precious Jean lack the ability to mount serious challenges. With two willing pace-setters ensuring a true test of stamina on soft ground over 2m5½f, this race strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and have the class to strike when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Set Honest Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Lisnamurrican and Grey Gamble maintain a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the weaker horses and set up the race for the classier prominent runners to strike in the final half-mile. Strong Run's recent hurdles form and That Is Blue's consistency will be crucial as the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lisnamurrican Dominates Class
scenarios.trigger: If Henderson's mare gets an uncontested lead or Grey Gamble fades early
scenarios.body: Despite her long absence, Lisnamurrican's superior class rating (OR 118) and proven soft ground form will tell as she controls the race from the front. Her jockey De Boinville will time the kick perfectly to ward off any late challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The pace setters will weaken dramatically in the final furlong, allowing the best of the prominent runners to come through late. Strong Run's recent winning form over hurdles makes him the most likely beneficiary of a collapse up front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Grey Gamble or That Is Blue could find extra reserves if the race falls apart, though both have question marks about their current form and ability respectively. This scenario requires the class horses to underperform significantly.

watchPoints.text: Lisnamurrican's fitness after 91 days off could see her fade dramatically if not fully wound up by Henderson
Strong Run carries 7lbs more than rivals which could tell in testing ground conditions over this extended trip
Grey Gamble's freshness after 155 days absence may help or hinder depending on Lavelle's preparation
That Is Blue needs significant improvement from recent moderate form to compete with higher-rated rivals
Wind operation on Precious Jean with tongue-tie added suggests connections hope for major improvement but form is dire

races.name: KSR Lighting, The Ultimate Lighting Solutions Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Carrigmoorna Rowan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who bled three runs back but showed competitive form for Potter, though going preference suggests he handles these conditions adequately.
runners_data.comment: Some decent efforts for current yard but he's now 0-8 over fences and this is a new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Became disappointing for Harry Fry; competitive form over hurdles and fences for current yard but he bled three runs back and couldn't hang in there at Exeter (2m3f, good) last time; continues to drop down the weights but he's now 0-8 over fences and is untried at this trip.

runners_data.name: Gold Clermont
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning after 41 days who won at this track in January 2024 and showed return to form last time with Charlie Bament's 7lb claim helping.
runners_data.comment: Back to form with a third over hurdles here last month; in the mix back over fences
runners_data.spotlight: All four wins have came over fences Andy Irvine; her last success was in January 2024 but that was at this track (3m3f) and she returned to form with a creditable third over hurdles here (3m2f, soft) last month; that was only her second start since rejoining her former stable and she's in the mix back over fences.

runners_data.name: Moonlit Potter
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who unseated at Hereford just 8 days ago when front-running, suggesting confidence issues over fences despite decent hurdles form.
runners_data.comment: On reduced mark but she's 0-9 over fences and unseated last week; risks attached
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler for Henry Daly in 2024 but she's been generally disappointing over fences and unseated at the seventh when front-running at Hereford last week; on dangerous mark but she's now 0-9 in this sphere and others are more convincing.

runners_data.name: Ballynaheer
runners_data.note: Progressive front-runner with excellent recent form (1221141) who won at Market Rasen 19 days ago and carries top weight as the likely pace-setter.
runners_data.comment: Progressive 7yo who has form figures of 1221141 since September; strongly respected
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive 7yo who has form figures of 1221141 over fences since September; only two completed when he scored at Market Rasen (3m, good) 19 days ago but he still looks on a workable mark and his first chase win was over C&D; strongly respected.

runners_data.name: Le Galli Bier
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 0-13 record who needs to prove stamina at this trip but showed respectable effort from out of the weights here last month.
runners_data.comment: Respectable efforts in last two runs but she's now 0-13 and is untried beyond 2m6f
runners_data.spotlight: Respectable effort from out of the weights in a higher grade here (2m3f, good to soft) last month but overall record is now 0-13 and he has stamina to prove at this new trip; others are more persuasive.

runners_data.name: Sweet Nightingale
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying bottom weight who broke through with 10-length Exeter win last month and benefits from Charlie Deutsch's tactical nous.
runners_data.comment: Won at Exeter on penultimate run and ran better than the bare facts last time; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Made the breakthrough over fences with 10l win at Exeter (3m, good) last month; was beaten by 10l when third of four at Plumpton (3m2f) last time but that was behind two progressive 6yos and her jockey went for home a circuit too soon; still has potential as a staying chaser and she's in the mix off same mark as last time.

runners_data.name: Edgewell
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in excellent form with back-to-back Hereford wins who faces 3lb rise but stayed on strongly last time to suggest further improvement possible.
runners_data.comment: Resurgent 8yo who has won at Hereford in his last two starts and he's a major player again
runners_data.spotlight: 8yo who has been resurgent with wins at Hereford (3m1f, good) in his last two starts; 3lb higher than last time but he stayed on strongly to beat a clear second and remains well handicapped on his best form; key player.

races.paceDynamic: Ballynaheer will make the running from flag to finish as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable gallop that won't come under early pressure. With prominent runners like Carrigmoorna Rowan, Moonlit Potter and Le Galli Bier tracking but none forcing the pace, this creates a tempo that will build gradually through the 3m2f trip. The lack of pace pressure means the leaders can conserve energy for a prolonged finish where stamina becomes paramount. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses like Gold Clermont, Sweet Nightingale and Edgewell who can track the modest early pace and unleash late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Artists Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Ballynaheer sets an even tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The patient runners get the perfect setup to close strongly in the final half-mile when stamina tells. Gold Clermont and Sweet Nightingale benefit most from their ability to quicken late off a steady pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Last Home
scenarios.trigger: If Ballynaheer's sustainable pace proves too strong for closers
scenarios.body: The front-runner maintains his advantage while prominent trackers like Carrigmoorna Rowan pick up the pieces when late challenges fail to materialise. The moderate early gallop leaves enough in reserve for those who travelled well throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from 2f out creating gaps
scenarios.body: Horses like Le Galli Bier and Moonlit Potter positioned perfectly in behind the leader can strike when Ballynaheer tires but before hold-up horses get into gear. This intermediate running style proves optimal when the race fragments.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Ballynaheer goes too fast early and the race becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The tempo becomes so steady that it turns into a sprint finish where class and tactical positioning matter more than stamina. Edgewell's recent winning form could prove decisive in a messy finish where anything can happen.

watchPoints.text: Moonlit Potter could repeat her unseating trick from Hereford if asked to force the pace early, potentially taking others down at the seventh fence.
Ballynaheer's front-running tactics will dictate the entire race tempo - if he goes too fast early, it opens the door for patient hold-up horses.
Gold Clermont returns after 41 days but her course win in January and strong going record suggests she could be primed for a big effort.
Le Galli Bier faces stamina questions at 3m2f having never won in 13 starts, making him vulnerable if the pace becomes truly testing.
Sweet Nightingale's 10-length breakthrough win suggests untapped potential that could be unleashed with patient hold-up tactics from Deutsch.

races.name: KSR Lighting Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Precious Metal
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 48-day break after pulling up in tough Sandown handicap, needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Had tough assignment at Sandown latest and he's still unexposed; one to keep an eye on
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner; pulled up in a Sandown handicap (2m4f, soft) last month but that was a tough assignment in a valuable event and he still has potential after only five runs in this sphere; needs checking in market on this drop back in grade.

runners_data.name: He's A Latchico
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent Fontwell record (11631), trainer struggling with 0/19 in last 14 days
runners_data.comment: Went close at Plumpton on penultimate run and he's 3-5 at Fontwell; interesting contender
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner who has form figures of 11631 at Fontwell; has mixed record this season but he went close at Plumpton (2m4f, soft) on his penultimate run and was rallying in a close fifth when he unseated two out at Kempton (2m, good) last time; one of two runners for the yard and he's an interesting contender back at this track.

runners_data.name: Calvino
runners_data.note: Sole front runner carrying 5lb claimer, must prove stamina after disappointing return at Taunton
runners_data.comment: Disappointing last time but he's still unexposed and is in the mix on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Fast-ground bumper winner who landed a Taunton novice (2m3f, good) in January but he was disappointing on his return visit the following month; bit to prove after that but he's still lightly raced and it wouldn't be a surprise if he resumed his progress on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Valadon
runners_data.note: Prominent type with tongue-tie fitted, coming off good recent form and handles testing ground well
runners_data.comment: In good form in his last two runs and he won this race last year; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Scored with a tongue-tie added at Plumpton (2m4f, good to soft) last month and he ran to a similar level when a 2l third at Wincanton (2m4f, good) last time; has been as good as ever in those last two runs and he won this race last year; respected.

runners_data.name: Yellow Star
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing cheekpieces, concerning recent form including fall at Newbury last time
runners_data.comment: Bounced back with a win at Warwick in December but has form figures of 00F since then
runners_data.spotlight: Bounced back with a win at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft) in December but he was tailed off in next two starts and he didn't get very far at Newbury (fell at third) last time; has plenty to prove again and he's still 3lb higher than for his last win.

runners_data.name: Jackomy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse on upward curve with two recent wins, proven at this trip and handles good ground
runners_data.comment: 6yo who has won in good style in last two runs and he's open to more progress; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo who justified favouritism in a Wincanton handicap (2m4f, good) last month and followed up with a dominant display at Ludlow (2m5f, good); up another 10lb but his form has really taken off recently and he's open to more progress; big player.

races.paceDynamic: Calvino is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a sustainable pace given no pressure from other early leaders. He's A Latchico, Valadon and Yellow Star will track prominently behind the leader, while Precious Metal and Jackomy are hold-up horses who need the race to develop. With only one horse wanting the lead, this sets up as a steady gallop that will quicken from the home turn. This tactical scenario strongly favours the prominent runners who can track Calvino and kick when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Calvino sets steady fractions and the prominent trackers get first run on him
scenarios.body: The pace will be manageable early allowing He's A Latchico, Valadon and Yellow Star to travel comfortably before striking. This eliminates Calvino's front-running advantage and suits horses with tactical speed over pure stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Calvino maintains his rhythm and sees off challenges from the home turn
scenarios.body: His sustainable early pace will have him well within himself when others come to him. The lack of early pressure means he can dictate when to quicken and control the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly pedestrian and the race becomes a sprint from 3f out
scenarios.body: Precious Metal and Jackomy will benefit from a slowly-run contest that becomes all about finishing kick. Their patient tactics will pay dividends in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Calvino stops or falls and the prominent runners are caught out of position
scenarios.body: The race would become scrappy with no clear pace-setter, potentially suiting horses that can adapt quickly. This chaos scenario could benefit the most versatile performers.

watchPoints.text: Yellow Star's recent falls and poor form suggest he could exit early and disrupt the field
Calvino with inexperienced 5lb claimer Paddy Hanlon may not get ideal fractions if challenged early
He's A Latchico's trainer Gary & Josh Moore running at 0/19 strike rate in last 14 days
Precious Metal returning from long break after pulling up, fitness could be questionable
Jackomy stepping up in grade after lower-level wins, faces stiffer test here

races.name: V2 Radio Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: West Orchard
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong course form and proven stamina who handles the going well
runners_data.comment: Unlike most of these he's been in fair form and return to hurdles no bother; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time winner over fences including here (about 2m 3f, good) in 2024; last ran over hurdles when second at Wincanton (about 3m, good to soft) and he returns to this sphere after a couple of errors at Plumpton last month; respected.

runners_data.name: Has Troke
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner returning from 66-day break but with solid course-and-distance credentials
runners_data.comment: 1-1 here; creditable effort in December wasn't built on but this is not a strong event
runners_data.spotlight: Course novice winner in 2022 who doubled his tally over hurdles at Lingfield (2m7f, also soft) last February; creditable seasonal reappearance in December wasn't built on and he finished 30l adrift having sprawled two out at Market Rasen two months ago; maybe just his second visit to this track will relight the fire but probably doesn't want the ground to dry out appreciably.

runners_data.name: Amalfi Skyline
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with 5lb claimer who needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Missed 2025 but signs he retained ability at this track last time; could be the answer
runners_data.spotlight: Hereford winner over fences (2m5f, good to soft) in 2024 who was also second over hurdles at Plumpton (3m1f, good) that year; missed 2025 and fell on his stable debut in February but there were signs he retained ability despite finishing last of five here (about 2m5f, soft) last month; possibilities in a thin event.

runners_data.name: Fravanco
runners_data.note: Prominent style but underwhelming hurdling debut suggests vulnerability at this level
runners_data.comment: Beaten 61l on handicap debut last month; up markedly in trip for this second go
runners_data.spotlight: Dual AW winner on the Flat who was 61l adrift when beating one home on his handicap hurdle debut at Kempton (2m) last month; just a fair effort on the Flat a fortnight ago; upped markedly in trip for his second go in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Counteract
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 881 days absence makes him hugely unpredictable
runners_data.comment: Big absence but this veteran returns on a dangerous mark; watch the market on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Dual chase winner in the spring of 2021 but he'd lost his form when last seen in November 2023; impossible to predict what this stable debut will produce but he's on a dangerous mark and the market should give firm indications.

runners_data.name: Shesupincourt
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in poor form who ran badly just 8 days ago
runners_data.comment: Losing run and big defeats are racking up; out of the weights
runners_data.spotlight: 2-31 over hurdles (soft/heavy) but the losing run is mounting up, as are a string of big defeats; the latest of those came at Hereford just eight days ago and she's out of the weights again.

runners_data.name: Simon The Seagull
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with 3lb claimer but lacks recent winning form

runners_data.name: Miss Jaffa Cake
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with uninspiring form figures and quick 12-day turnaround
runners_data.comment: Hint of ability hasn't been confirmed; out of the weights
runners_data.spotlight: Not the biggest and her form figures are uninspiring but there were hints of ability before unseating in Wincanton novice in January; subsequent efforts suggest that might have been a false dawn and she's out of the weights again.

runners_data.name: Approaching Storm
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades in finish and making handicap debut
runners_data.comment: Not much to shout about in three qualifying runs; new trip for h'cap debut; may do better
runners_data.spotlight: Not too much encouragement in three maiden hurdles at up to 2m4f but there was a whiff of something on penultimate start and this new trip might help on her handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Has Troke will lead with his confirmed front-running style, likely joined by West Orchard and possibly Fravanco in the early stages. The small field and 3m2f distance should produce a sustainable gallop rather than fierce early pace, with the genuine tempo building from the back straight. Multiple hold-up horses (Amalfi Skyline, Counteract, Simon The Seagull, Miss Jaffa Cake, Approaching Storm) will rely on the leaders maintaining honest pace throughout. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and front runners who can dictate terms without severe early pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Has Troke gets an uncontested lead and sustains gallop
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest but not punishing, allowing him to kick clear approaching the last with West Orchard tracking. Hold-up horses will find too much ground to make up in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If West Orchard and Fravanco press Has Troke from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will test stamina reserves but create a genuine gallop for closers. West Orchard's class and course form gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and leaders tire dramatically
scenarios.body: Amalfi Skyline and Simon The Seagull will benefit from a sprint finish scenario on the testing ground. Their fresh legs will count most in a tactical affair turned into a staying test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Has Troke goes too fast early under pressure and field bunches
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with tired leaders vulnerable to any horse with energy reserves. Counteract's long absence becomes irrelevant in a slowly-run staying test.

watchPoints.text: Has Troke's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes will compromise his front-running tactics
West Orchard's stamina at this extended trip - he's usually seen over shorter distances
Counteract's fitness after 881 days off - stable debut following such a long layoff is unpredictable
Amalfi Skyline and Simon The Seagull benefiting from claiming allowances in weak handicap
Early pace development between Has Troke, West Orchard and Fravanco will determine tactical shape

races.name: A.W. Jeffreys (Southampton) Ltd Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: It's A Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner switching from hurdles to fences for Paul Nicholls, but poor recent form suggests he needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: 0-9 over hurdles, best effort when second at Wincanton penultimate start; chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles; did finish second in a 3m Wincanton handicap (good to soft) last month but only sixth back there since; switches to fences in a bid to get straight back on track for leading stable.

runners_data.name: Kitsilano
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose two wins came on heavy ground, giving him a slight edge on this soft surface over the others
runners_data.comment: Won a 2m chase on heavy in February but remote fourth latest; new headgear on now
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins on heavy, latterly a 2m chase at Leicester in February; creditable third at Plumpton next time but didn't jump well when remote fourth over 2m5f here (good to soft) four weeks ago; on the back of that the cheekpieces he's worn on his last five outings are replaced by a first-time visor.

runners_data.name: Hatos
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for in-form Joe Tizzard but all wins have required heavy ground which may be a concern here
runners_data.comment: Placed on last three starts (including C&D) but is now over two years since last win
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins have been on heavy ground; C&D second in January was also on soft but his two placed efforts over 2m4f at Wincanton since came on good to soft and good; ought to be thereabouts again but it is now over two years since his last win.

runners_data.name: Majestic Moment
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose recent course win was fortunate but followed up well, making him a key contender from off the pace
runners_data.comment: Fortunate winner here in autumn but no luck involved in recent Exeter success; player
runners_data.spotlight: His 2m2f course success in October was very fortunate (looked held in dispute of third when left to finish alone at the last) but there was no luck involved when returning from a break to land a second chase win at Exeter (2m3f, good) 17 days ago; a 4lb rise shouldn't prevent another bold bid.

runners_data.name: Gorcombe Moonshine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who was narrowly beaten here 16 days ago and drops significantly in weight
runners_data.comment: 1-34 but the win came here and he also went close over C&D latest; another to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Just 1-34 under rules but the win came here (in 2023) and he went very close to a second course success 16 days ago, going down by only a head over this trip on good to soft; another who could be involved in the finish.

runners_data.name: Ballybay
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner but poor recent form and long absence of competitive efforts make him hard to recommend

runners_data.name: King Of The Story
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 148-day break with mixed recent record of wins and pull-ups
runners_data.comment: Three wins and three PUs from last six starts; hard to know what to expect back from break
runners_data.spotlight: Had a very hit-and-miss record when last seen, with his six outings between July and November resulting in three wins (all 2m4f, good) and three pulled ups; hard to know what mood he'll show up in after five months off.

runners_data.name: A Little Something
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who improved significantly when switched back to better ground after heavy ground excuse
runners_data.comment: Pulled up on chase debut but much better when second at Ludlow since; enters calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Had heavy ground as an excuse when pulled up on chase debut in February after nine months off and fared a lot better back on a sounder surface when second of six at Ludlow (2m4f, good) 25 days ago; her jumping was a bit iffy but is entitled to get better with experience; enters calculations.

runners_data.name: Jaffa Cake
runners_data.note: The sole front runner but recent form shows concerning tendency to weaken quickly in the closing stages
runners_data.comment: Still days but pulled up both handicap hurdles; switches to fences with headgear added
runners_data.spotlight: Mostly disappointing since finishing second in a bumper last spring, weakening quickly and pulled up in both handicap hurdles in recent months; too soon to write off but switches to fences with something to prove; a first-time hood and tongue-tie combination is also added.

runners_data.name: Greenways
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose recent form has declined markedly since winning at Uttoxeter
runners_data.comment: Largely below par since Uttoxeter win last summer, finishing well-held third latest
runners_data.spotlight: Successful over 2m at Uttoxeter (good) but out of form since, with recent 14.5l third at Market Rasen (2m1f, good) no big step back in the right direction.

runners_data.name: Millies Mite
runners_data.note: Prominent type who was traveling well here 16 days ago before unseating, suggesting return to form
runners_data.comment: Looked back in better form when unseating latest and has won last two runnings of this
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up on her final two outings in 2025 but looked in much better form back from a break here 16 days ago, moving well close to the pace when unseating four out; has won the last two runnings of this race off similar marks and could be set for another bold bid.

runners_data.name: Fourtwofour
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making stable debut but poor Irish form suggests opening mark may still be too high
runners_data.comment: Looks on stiff mark on hurdle/point form in Ireland now debuting over fences for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten upwards of 43l in three maiden hurdles in Ireland and 19l third on his completed start in points there in the autumn; tough to argue his opening mark looks generous now switching to fences for a new yard.

races.paceDynamic: Jaffa Cake provides the only confirmed pace angle as the sole front runner, but his recent form shows weakening tendencies which could create a false tempo early. With prominent runners Hatos, Gorcombe Moonshine, Greenways and Millies Mite likely to track close behind, the pace should be honest but not frantic over this 2m3½f trip on soft ground. The combination of one questionable leader and multiple prominent types suggests the pace will be sustainable early before quickening from the back of the last fence. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish, particularly those with proven soft ground form like Kitsilano, Majestic Moment and A Little Something.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Jaffa Cake stops quickly and the prominent runners fail to pick up the tempo sufficiently
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where stamina at the trip becomes secondary to a sharp turn of foot. Hold-up horses with class like Kitsilano and Majestic Moment can unleash finishing kicks that the pace-tracking horses cannot match.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Honest Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain pressure after Jaffa Cake weakens turning in
scenarios.body: A true test of stamina develops where horses need to have traveled well and jump the last three fences under pressure. Those who have raced prominently but with something left can edge out pure closers who get too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Jaffa Cake goes off hard early or if multiple prominent runners challenge him for the lead
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and causes the front division to come back markedly in the straight. Pure hold-up horses get the perfect setup but need the class and finishing kick to capitalize on the strong early gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or falls significantly disrupt the field and destroy the race rhythm
scenarios.body: The contest becomes about who can adapt best to the changing circumstances and who has the tactical speed to capitalize on gaps. Prominent runners who avoid trouble and can quicken when others are struggling gain the advantage.

watchPoints.text: Jaffa Cake's jumping and stamina reserves as the lone leader, as any early departure leaves the field without clear pace
How quickly the prominent runners Hatos, Gorcombe Moonshine and Millies Mite commit to tracking the leader through the early stages
Whether Kitsilano and Majestic Moment can secure good positions early enough to unleash their finishing kicks without getting too far back

races.name: Fontwell Park Weddings & Events Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Superstylin
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent Fontwell form including two wins here, drops back to proven trip and handles conditions well
runners_data.comment: Three chase wins this season and he looks interesting off lower mark back over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins over fences this season and last two have been at Fontwell (2m2f/2m3f, good to soft); well-held second of four at Plumpton 19 days ago but that was behind an improver from the Nicholls yard; 10lb lower on this return to hurdling and he's an interesting contender in suitable conditions.

runners_data.name: Blue Universe
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer who ran well off this mark at Huntingdon on soft, returns after 78-day break
runners_data.comment: 0-12 over hurdles but he was runner-up off this mark at Huntingdon last time; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: 0-12 over hurdles but he ran well to finished second off this mark at Huntingdon (2m3f, soft) in February; this is a deeper race but he's versatile ground-wise and has each-way claims again after a short break.

runners_data.name: Dontaskchris
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning after 715 days off, completely unknown quantity with minimal recent form

runners_data.name: Spanish Dancer
runners_data.note: Prominent type who has been well-held in recent qualifying runs, needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Unexposed 7yo and he's a possible improver upped in trip on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to four winners including Bal Celtique (French 2m1f-2m3f hurdle/chase); well-held fifth in his three qualifying runs but he showed some promise behind some useful rivals; looks a possible improver now upped in trip on handicap debut and he needs watching in market.

runners_data.name: Calshot Spit
runners_data.note: Course winner who handles all ground conditions, back off same mark as December victory here
runners_data.comment: Won here in December but he's struggled in both runs since; needs to bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: Acts on fast and heavy ground; dual course winner, more recently when clinging on by a short head in December (2m2f, heavy ground); back on the same mark today but he's struggled in his last two runs and needs to get back on track.

runners_data.name: Jefe Triunfo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in poor form, was tailed off on reappearance 18 days ago at Plumpton
runners_data.comment: Has gone the wrong way in handicaps and was tailed off on Plumpton reappearance; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle at Warwick (2m, good) last June but he's gone the wrong way in handicaps and was tailed off on Plumpton reappearance (2m4f, good) two weeks ago; mark continues to fall but he has something to prove.

runners_data.name: Bread And Butter
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer out of sorts recently, last win was 16 months ago
runners_data.comment: His last success was 16 months ago and he's been out of sorts in his last four runs
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner (2m3f-2m5f) but his last success was 16 months ago and this veteran has been out of sorts in his last four runs; opposable.

runners_data.name: My Lovely Horse
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner with 39 days since last run, will dictate pace throughout race

runners_data.name: Hiero Sport
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning to form with good third last time, handles testing conditions
runners_data.comment: Back from another break with a fair third at Huntingdon three weeks ago; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Defied this mark at Fakenham (2m4f, good) in October 2024; only four runs since but he returned after another break with a front-running third at Huntingdon (2m5f) three weeks ago; should benefit from that run and he's not ruled out on this drop back in trip.

runners_data.name: Easter Icon
runners_data.note: Prominent type showing signs of return to form, wears cheekpieces for focus
runners_data.comment: Course winner who showed signs of a revival at Stratford last month; could be dangerous
runners_data.spotlight: Productive spell from August 2024 to April 2025 over hurdles and on the Flat; has had some struggles in a light campaign this season but he showed signs of a revival at Stratford (2m6f, good) last month and has possibilities if he can build on that.

runners_data.name: Nelson Gate
runners_data.note: Young prominent horse who is an 11-race maiden, showed promise when second here previously
runners_data.comment: Unexposed hurdler and he needs watching in market at this new trip on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: 11-race maiden under both codes; tailed off in last two hurdle runs but he showed some promise when runner-up in a juvenile event here (2m2f, good to soft) in November; now goes handicapping at this new trip and he needs watching in market after 111 days off; cheekpieces reapplied.

runners_data.name: Chosen Bae
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer just 8 days since last run at Hereford, well out of handicap
runners_data.comment: Well held in all eight runs this season and he's out of the weights again; no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Won handicap debut at Bangor (2m3f, soft) last February 2025 but he's been well held in eight runs this season and latest was at Hereford last week; out of the weights again and he can only be watched.

runners_data.name: Bushstreet Bowman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendency in finishes, poor recent form continues

races.paceDynamic: My Lovely Horse is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a steady pace without pressure from other leaders. The prominent racers like Superstylin, Blue Universe, Calshot Spit and Hiero Sport will track the leader closely, creating a compact group through the early stages. With multiple hold-up horses including Jefe Triunfo, Bread And Butter, Dontaskchris and Bushstreet Bowman needing to be produced late, the race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning matters crucially. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours prominent racers who can stay close to My Lovely Horse and kick when the tempo lifts, rather than hold-up horses who may struggle to make up ground on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If My Lovely Horse sets steady fractions and the prominent group stays compact
scenarios.body: The likes of Superstylin, Blue Universe and Calshot Spit can track the leader easily and have first run on the hold-up horses when the pace quickens. Their tactical positioning proves decisive as the soft ground makes it harder for back-markers to close effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If My Lovely Horse gets an easy lead and has enough left in the tank
scenarios.body: With no pace pressure early, My Lovely Horse can control the race completely and may have enough stamina reserves to hold off late challengers. The reduced weight advantage and lack of early pressure could be decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong mid-race and prominent horses tie up
scenarios.body: Strong early gallop between the prominent horses allows hold-up specialists like Jefe Triunfo and Dontaskchris to pick up the pieces late. The testing conditions suit horses with a strong finishing kick who haven't been involved in early battles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Longshot Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the main contenders all encounter trouble or the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: Chaos in running or an exceptionally weak pace allows an outsider like Nelson Gate or Spanish Dancer to steal the race. Multiple fallers or a tactical mess creates opportunities for horses with minimal winning chances.
